author: Agent_Penguin
body: Recently, a new map was released in nebula, illegal office. I joined a game (map was illegal office) and in the second half of the match, both teams were spawn killing people the instant they spawned and digging holes in the spawn area. To fix this problem, I recommend adding spawn protection to that this doesn't happen again in the future.
